title: Cooling Performance and Seat Ventilation
summary: This topic is mostly undetermined and combines cooling strength, seat ventilation behavior, and a few unrelated weak-point comments, with only one clear positive example about climate preconditioning guidance.

positive.summary: One positive review praises preconditioning while plugged in as a useful way to manage cabin heating or cooling without wasting battery.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention weak cooling, missing or inconsistent seat cooling, rear-seat cooling complaints, and a few unrelated remarks about brakes, navigation software, and expectations.

limitations: Most examples are labeled undetermined, so clear sentiment conclusions are limited.
